title: Closet
content: I have been having mall world dreams ever since I was a child. But last night's dream really stuck out to me. For me to get to mall world in my dreams id have to go to my childhood bedroom closet and walk in and id be there. Last night in my dream I met some people and they followed me back to the closet and for some reason I thought they were in real life. I had to hide them from everyone because people wouldnt believe me who they were? I dont know why this dream stuck out to me but it does like a sore thumb.
